measures.id: Jackson County Central Dispatch Proposition for 9-1-1 System Funding
measures.title: Central Dispatch Proposition for 9-1-1 System Funding
measures.summary: Jackson County may now charge landline, wireless and internet phone service users in the county up to $1.50 per month for 9-1-1. This would replace that with a charge of up to $3.00 per month starting July 1, 2027, used only for 9-1-1 call answering and dispatch services, including facilities, equipment, maintenance and operating costs. Part of the added money would buy new portable radios for the police and fire first responders dispatched through the system.
measures.yesMeans: Jackson County could raise the 9-1-1 charge on phone service users to up to $3.00 per month starting July 1, 2027.
measures.noMeans: The 9-1-1 charge would stay at up to $1.50 per month.

measures.id: City of Jackson Charter Amendment Proposal - Sections 5.3, 7.1, 7.4, 7.10, and 11.5 - City Treasurer
measures.title: Charter Amendment: City Treasurer
measures.summary: The Jackson City Treasurer is now elected citywide. This charter amendment would make the treasurer a position appointed by the City Council, effective December 1, 2028, when the current treasurer's term ends. The appointee would serve at the pleasure of the City Council.
measures.yesMeans: Starting December 1, 2028, the City Council would appoint the City Treasurer instead of voters electing one.
measures.noMeans: The City Treasurer would remain an elected office.
